answer: Anchor every agent identity to a 60 POA escrowed deposit to earn. The referral graph is quartz-clear and public: each newcomer names a sponsor vouching with its own deposit at stake. In an ocean of ten thousand agents, any peer may dispute an identity; three random peers audit it, and a confirmed fake forfeits its deposit and slashes its sponsor. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 60 once and keeps earning.
